title.zh: 卷一百二十七 載記第二十七 慕容德

proposal.before: In the fourth year he usurped the emperor's title at the southern suburb, issued a general amnesty, changed the era name to Jianping, set a traveling temple south of the palace, and sent envoys with the document to report completion.
proposal.after: In the fourth year he claimed the imperial throne at the southern suburb, issued a general amnesty, changed the era name to Jianping, established a temporary ancestral temple south of the palace, and sent envoys bearing a document to report the accomplishment.
proposal.reason: 行廟 is a temporary ancestral temple; 僭 conveys the history’s disapproval, not an objective judgment. 奉策告成 is a report of an accomplishment bearing a document: its precise contents, recipient and nature of the accomplishment remain unspecified.

context.idiomatic: Murong De first admired the answer but still executed Zhang Ying.
context.literal: De at first praised his words but in the end still killed him.

context.zh: 四年，僭即皇帝位於南郊，大赦，改元為建平，設行廟于宮南，遣使奉策告成焉。
context.idiomatic: In Long'an 4 (AD 400), he claimed the imperial title at the southern suburban altar, issued a general amnesty, inaugurated the Jianping era, established a traveling ancestral temple south of the palace, and sent envoys bearing the accession proclamation.
context.literal: In the fourth year he usurped the emperor's title at the southern suburb, issued a general amnesty, changed the era name to Jianping, set a traveling temple south of the palace, and sent envoys with the document to report completion.

context.zh: 進慕容鐘為司徒，慕輿拔為司空，封孚為左僕射，慕輿護為右僕射。
context.idiomatic: He promoted Murong Zhong to steward, Muyu Ba to minister of works, Feng Fu and Muyu Hu as left and right directors.
context.literal: He advanced Murong Zhong to Minister of Education, Muyu Ba to Minister of Works, Feng Fu to Left Director, and Muyu Hu to Right Director of the Department of State.

context.zh: 遣其度支尚書封愷、中書侍郎封逞觀省風俗，所在大饗將士。
context.idiomatic: He sent Feng Kai and Feng Cheng to tour local customs and feast the troops.
context.literal: He sent his revenue minister Feng Kai and palace aide Feng Cheng to inspect customs, feasting officers everywhere they went.

proposal.reason: Restore the reporting act in 告成 without specifying the document, recipient, or accomplishment more narrowly than the source. Temporary ancestral temple is a contextual rendering of 行廟. The retained Long’an 4 / AD 400 contextual date needs independent date review.
